description: This header file defines utility functions, classes, and constants for AAudio, an Android audio API. It includes functions for converting between AAudio and Android system types, managing thread synchronization, handling audio channel masks, and reading system properties related to audio timing and logging. It also declares classes for double buffering, timestamp management, and thread request handling.
